about: The visitors' own walls: where the pictures they take (photo mode, Saved/Postcards) and anything dropped into Saved/Maker hang. Campus metres (x east, y up, z south); the actor stands against the wall at the row's height, facing the room (yaw = Unreal degrees, 0 = looking east). width_m = the wall's usable width. wta_setup/actors.py spawns an AWTAGalleryWallActor per entry.
